To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the AP- 3 adaptor complex is involved in the biogenesis/functioning of organelles and that abrogating expression of the AP3 complex causes platelet SPD.
the expression of the AP3 complex is altered in the pearl mouse, and that this alteration is associated with lysosomal and platelet storage pool abnormalities.
the beta3A gene product of the AP- 3 complex, when mutated, results in the pearl phenotype, which includes SPD in platelets and abnormal lysosomes in other tissues.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the molecular mechanisms of platelet biogenesis and function and has implications for the pathogenesis of platelet storage pool deficiencies.
the molecular basis of the platelet storage pool disorder of the pearl mouse, a model for Hermanksy Pudlak Syndrome.
the molecular basis of platelet storage pool deficiencies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
AP-3 is a lysosome biogenesis factor.
pearl mice are a model of HPS, that HPS is a disorder of the AP- 3 complex, and that platelet SPD is a consequence of HPS.
the AP- 3 complex is a lysosomal trafficking regulator that is required for biogenesis/function of platelet granules.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the AP- 3 complex plays an essential role in biogenesis and function of organelles, and that the absence of the complex leads to platelets and other cell defects.
the AP- 3 complex is required for the biogenesis/functioning of platelet granules and lysosomal organelles.
the AP- 3 complex regulates the formation and function of organelles, including melanosomes and lysosomes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have shown that AP-3 subunit proteins are expressed in a wide variety of cell types and that they are localized to the cytoplasm in cells that lack beta3A.
the AP- 3 adaptor complex plays a role in biogenesis/function of lysosomes and platelet storage granules and that the absence of AP-3 leads to platelet storage granule deficiency.
we found that the AP3 complex is involved in the biogenesis of lysosomes, and that the pearl mutant mouse is a model of a lysosomal disease.
